summary: Resolved the remaining P2 finding: canonical work parents no longer receive a single release suggestion. Explicit is_leaf metadata takes precedence; estimate.is_parent supports older responses without shape metadata, and legacy epics remain excluded. Leaf Done, QA, ETA, queue and published-membership behavior is preserved. No assertion was relaxed.

ownership.attribution: Coordinator recorded worker marker before dispatch, per worker-common.md. Account verified with paimos --instance ppm whoami. No tracker writes or status changes.

findings.finding: Migrated parents receive misleading release predictions
findings.changes: Extend SuggestionInput with parent/leaf metadata; return the existing empty suggestion before evaluating Done, ETA, queue or published membership. The explanation says that a parent’s leaves can span releases. Existing SuggestedReleaseCell and layout are reused.

regression.node: 84 parent combinations across work/ticket/task/epic, three metadata shapes and seven status spellings, plus the legacy epic fallback. Canonical leaves cover 21 metadata/state combinations with published version assertions and a Done leaf without measured cadence. Explicit leaf metadata wins over estimate metadata.
regression.browser: Six cases across 390/1024/1440 px and light/dark render a Done canonical parent, a Done leaf and a delivered leaf. Require empty parent text/class and accessible reason, unchanged Next release and published codename for leaves, positive-size control samples within 0.5 px, no horizontal overflow, no request writes and no browser errors.

baseline.method: Final unchanged test file executed with a Node registerHooks load hook substituting only the exact baseline suggestedRelease.ts from git show. All tracked production/test files remained unchanged.
baseline.failure: The canonical work parent with is_leaf:false and state:done returns planned / Next release on baseline rather than empty / em dash. Existing and new leaf assertions pass on baseline.

browser.selection: Six new canonical parent cases plus existing shared queued leaf prediction case. No full spec or full suite run.
browser.platform: macOS, pinned Playwright Chromium 153 headless shell
browser.stability: All six new cases measure parent row and its open action after parent/leaf tooltip interactions, with document overflow checks.
browser.fixture_correction: Initial browser run reached all UI and stability assertions but failed the no-write assertion on unrelated first-visit release preference initialization. Set the fixture last_seen preference; every assertion was retained and the final run passes.

remote_browser.reason: Approved scripts/playwright-remote.mjs refused OPS-247 bootstrap/launcher unavailable before SSH or transfer. Permitted single-file local fallback used one worker.

validation.remote_test_sh: Not invoked: it transfers HEAD with git push to a temporary ref. Preserved direct user instruction not to push. No Go package changed in this round.

validation.visual_verification: Inspected the 390 px light and 1440 px dark screenshots: empty parent prediction, preserved leaf suggestion, established list/card layout. All six screenshots were generated; no new layout or controls.
validation.full_suites: No fresh full Go/DB suite, npm build/typecheck, full web unit suite, Linux Chromium or hosted CI rerun claimed. Remote/CI validation remains coordinator-owned under the no-push instruction.

design_decisions: No conflict with approved design fragments or Markus decisions. This changes eligibility and explanation within existing UI, with no layout or new control. No new UI design is introduced.
constraints: Assigned worktree and branch only; no push, deploy, production mutation, tracker status/version/migration change, secrets or credentials, foreign-worktree edits, subagents or model review gates.
